about: Phase 7 (prompts/phase-07-analysis.md step 4): a small weighted, undirected graph exercising every centrality function on the same input — degree, closeness (Wasserman & Faust's disconnected-safe form), betweenness (Brandes, weighted), eigenvector (power iteration). Mirrors `analysis::centrality::tests::star` at 4 leaves; the numbers below are hand-checked, not re-derived from the Rust output, so they also serve as an independent check on it.

betweenness.center: > 0: every leaf-leaf shortest path (all 6 pairs) crosses it
betweenness.leaves: 0: no leaf sits on any other pair's shortest path

closeness.why: center reaches all 4 leaves at distance 0.5 each; a leaf reaches the center at 0.5 and every other leaf at 1.0 (through the center) — the center is strictly closer to everyone than any leaf is

eigenvector.why: a star is bipartite (center vs. leaves): its two extremal eigenvalues tie in magnitude, so plain power iteration oscillates rather than settling — see fixtures/analysis/star.json and the eigenvector Ponytail in crates/graph-cli/src/capabilities/analysis.rs
